description: Representative coding-agent interactions. Required terms are deterministic quality floors, not a substitute for human review.

cases.prompt: Explain what this authorization check does and when it returns false: `user.role == "admin" && account.active`.
Tests pass locally but fail in CI after a dependency update. Give the first two checks you would make.
Plan a CSV export for a report page. Include authorization, implementation, and tests.
Review this change: `DELETE /projects/:projectId/reports/:id` loads the report by `id` and deletes it without checking whether the current user belongs to `projectId`. State the finding and the fix.
Write a status update: report filters now persist in the URL, browser history works, invalid filters have a regression test, and there is no API or migration change.
